test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Nine men went to a restaurant. Eight of them spent Rs. 3 each on their meals and the ninth spent Rs. 2 more than the average expenditure of all the nine. Determine the total money spent by them.
solution:
**Given:**

Eight men spent Rs. 3 each

The ninth man spent Rs. 2 more than the average expenditure of all the nine men

**Formula used:**

Average expenditure = Total expenditure / Number of people

Total expenditure = Sum of individual expenditures

**Calculations:**

Total expenditure of eight men = 8 × 3 = Rs. 24

Let the total expenditure of all nine men be Rs. X

Average expenditure of all nine men = X / 9

Expenditure of the ninth man = X / 9 + 2

Sum of expenditures = Total expenditure

⇒ 24 + X / 9 + 2 = X

⇒ 26 + X / 9 = X

⇒ 26 = X - X / 9

⇒ 26 = 8X / 9

⇒ 26 × 9 = 8X

⇒ 234 = 8X

⇒ X = 234 / 8

⇒ X = 29.25

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
